items.source: the builder instance
Builds and returns a new VectorStore instance with the configured settings.
items.translation: 构建并返回一个具有配置设置的新 VectorStore 实例。

items.source: Sets the name of the unique constraint.
Sets the distance type for index storage and queries.
items.translation: 设置索引存储和查询的距离类型。

items.source: Sets the property name for storing embeddings.
items.translation: 设置用于存储嵌入的属性名称。

items.source: Sets the property name for document IDs.
items.translation: 设置文档 ID 的属性名称。

items.source: Sets the name of the vector index.
Sets whether to initialize the schema.
Sets the label for document nodes.
Sets the session configuration directly.
Sets the property name for text-content.
items.translation: 设置文本内容的属性名称。

items.source: Sets the FilterExpressionConverter to use when converting filter expressions to Neo4j Cypher queries. Defaults to Neo4jVectorFilterExpressionConverter.
items.translation: 设置用于将过滤表达式转换为 Neo4j Cypher 查询的FilterExpressionConverter。默认值为Neo4jVectorFilterExpressionConverter。

items.source: Description copied from interface: VectorStore.Builder
Sets the FilterExpressionConverter to use when converting filter expressions to Neo4j Cypher queries.
items.translation: 设置用于将过滤表达式转换为 Neo4j Cypher 查询的FilterExpressionConverter。

items.source: Sets the database name.
Sets the embedding dimension.

Sets the database name. When provided and not blank, creates a session config
for that database.
items.translation: 设置数据库名称。当提供且不为空时，为该数据库创建会话配置。

items.source: Sets the embedding dimension. Must be positive.
items.translation: 设置嵌入维度。必须为正数。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if dimension is less than 1
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果维度小于 1

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if distanceType is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果 distanceType 为 null

items.source: databaseName - the database name to use
sessionConfig - the session configuration to use
dimension - the dimension of the embedding
distanceType - the distance type to use
label - the label to use
embeddingProperty - the property name to use
indexName - the index name to use
idProperty - the property name to use
textProperty - the text property to use
constraintName - the constraint name to use
initializeSchema - true to initialize schema, false otherwise
items.translation: initializeSchema - 用于初始化架构，true 表示启用，false 表示禁用

items.source: filterExpressionConverter - the filter expression converter to use
items.translation: filterExpressionConverter - 要使用的过滤器表达式转换器
